title: I recreated the popular Sandtris game using AI/Fable 5
author: snorlaxerr
selftext:
Hi!  
I recreated the popular game which is Tetris but with sand blocks using AI/Fable 5 & using agents/skills kit (agentsguild.co) 

I have been using AI since past 3 years for making games. My first game with AI reached 65 million+ players across major web-game platforms :D 

  
Fun to see how the models improve everyday unlocking greater creativity.

replies.author: No-Marionberry-772
replies.body:
it is si ple though. a line match would be a flood fill that gates on color and looks to connect the two side walls, which would just be checking the min and max X position.  and tetris is tetris.  Sand game physics is also very simple where a pixel is moved by just checking the 3 adjacent cells below the pixel to see if the pixel can move into a free space and then moving it.

changing the tetria blocks to colored sand is a simple pixel perfect collision check.

this game is all like, 1st or 2nd year college level difficulty programming.   
its the idea thats interesting and fresh.

you can get a little more interesting by using double buffering on the environment.
